problem.explanation: Normally you would manipulate pointers. Here you just reverse the list. If you simulate it, iterate and build a new list by prepending.
problem.reference_solution:
def reverse_linked_list(vals: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return vals[::-1]
problem.statement_markdown: Given the values of a singly linked list, reverse it and return the values in the new order. (Represented as a list of integers for simplicity).
problem.title: Reverse linked list
